title: Wantzel-Galois Constructibility from Mathlib
description: Survey of proving the Wantzel-Galois characterization (constructible iff 2-group Galois) from Mathlib. Identifies the constructible number field definition as the main gap.

meta.assumptions: No axioms. 2 sorries in helper lemma about odd divisors of 2-powers.

overview.text: Survey of Wantzel-Galois characterization provability from Mathlib Galois theory.
keyInsights: Main gap: constructible number definition not in Mathlib
Key lemma: divisors of 2^k are powers of 2 (partially proved)
natDegree_dvd_card_gal from OQ-02-OQ-01 bridges Galois group to degree

conclusion.summary: The constructible number field definition is the main missing piece. Once formalized, the Wantzel-Galois characterization follows from existing Mathlib infrastructure.
